annotations.title: Audit B2B Revenue Leakage & Dispute Readiness

description: Run a deterministic 90-day B2B revenue leakage and chargeback readiness audit across Stripe subscriptions, AI/API usage telemetry events, and open disputes. Executes as a 100% read-only, stateless diagnostic with zero external Stripe mutations. Returns structuredContent containing ok, mode, statelessEphemeralAudit, tenantId, dunningGracePeriodDays, costPerEventCents, and audit (scannedCustomers, scannedEvents, ghostLeakEventsCount, affectedCustomersCount, estimatedBleedUsd, disputesEligibleForAutoEvidence). Use this tool for portfolio-wide multi-customer audits; use revclamp_evaluate_ghost_usage for single-customer entitlement checks or revclamp_stage_stripe_dispute_ce3 to build a single dispute's Visa CE 3.0 evidence bundle.

costPerEventCents.description: Estimated marginal compute or API cost per leaked usage event in integer USD cents (valid range: 1 to 100000, default: 142 i.e. $1.42/event).

customers.description: Optional array of up to 50 Stripe customer snapshots (each with id like 'cus_123', optional email, subscriptions array or list object, and subscriptionsHasMore: false). Omit to run against workspace telemetry or deterministic sandbox fixtures.

demo.description: Optional simulation flag (boolean) for deterministic sample audit preview.

disputes.description: Optional array of up to 50 Stripe dispute objects (each with id like 'du_123', customer, amount in cents, reason such as 'fraudulent', and status such as 'needs_response').

dunningGracePeriodDays.description: Custom dunning grace window in integer days (valid range: 0 to 14, default: 3) allowed after latest_invoice_failed_at before flagging past_due subscriptions as unpaid ghost usage.

usageEvents.description: Optional array of up to 200 product/AI API usage telemetry events (each with stripe_customer_id or email, event_name, and occurredAtSec Unix timestamp in seconds).

name: revclamp_audit_revenue_leakage
title: Audit B2B Revenue Leakage & Dispute Readiness
